samples.name: Celebration Jump
samples.description: Goal celebration: jump with arms spread wide, quick turn.
samples.default_prompt: A footballer celebrating a goal: leaping with both arms spread wide, then turning quickly. Keep the whole body in frame and the movement energetic.

samples.name: Penalty Kick Run-up
samples.description: Running up and striking a penalty kick, low-angle night shot.
samples.default_prompt: A footballer running up and striking a penalty kick at night. Keep the football visible at their feet through the run-up, and show the strike clearly.

samples.name: Freestyle Juggling (Night Pitch)
samples.description: Solo freestyle ball juggling on an empty floodlit pitch, full body, 6s.
samples.default_prompt: A footballer freestyling on a floodlit pitch, juggling a football continuously. Keep the ball visible throughout, in contact with their feet and knees.

samples.name: Freestyle Juggling (Parking Lot)
samples.description: Solo freestyle ball juggling in an empty parking lot, full body, 6s.
samples.default_prompt: A footballer freestyling in an empty parking lot, juggling a football continuously. Keep the ball visible throughout, in contact with their feet and knees.
